acceptanceCriteria: A read-only command takes one base and N candidate refs and emits one comparison record citing each candidate's CEM digest and reviewer report; it mutates no repository or trace state (invariant 4).
Each compared dimension cites its evidence; a candidate lacking a CEM or report shows NOT_PRODUCED for that dimension rather than a score.
No model-authored merge of candidates is in scope; any recommended pick names the evidence that separates the candidates or abstains.
body:
Filed 2026-10-22 from a review of openchamber/openchamber (MIT) 'Multi-run' and 'Fusion'.

OpenChamber runs one prompt on up to five models, each in its own worktree, then leaves comparison to the human (or an LLM 'Fusion' merge). Corvint can do the comparison with evidence instead of taste: for N candidate branches against one base and one ticket, a read-only report of each candidate's acceptance-criterion coverage, witnessed versus unwitnessed hunks, reviewer-report uncertainties and abstentions, affected-test results and diff size. It ranks nothing it cannot cite; missing evidence for a candidate is shown as NOT_PRODUCED, not as a loss.

Useful where lanes or hosts already produce competing attempts (Tasks attempts, maxActiveAttempts) and the owner picks one.
title: Compare candidate changes for one ticket by their evidence: a read-only side-by-side of N candidate branches' CEMs and reviewer reports
